name: Tim Dettmers
fame_basis: Creator and maintainer of bitsandbytes and first author of QLoRA and LLM.int8(), widely used for low-memory LLM finetuning and inference; academic researcher with about 1,500 GitHub followers.
bio: Tim Dettmers is an assistant professor at Carnegie Mellon University and a research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI. They created and maintain the bitsandbytes library and work on making large models cheaper to train and run, with a current focus on agents.
known_for: QLoRA efficient finetuning of quantized LLMs
LLM.int8() and k-bit inference scaling laws
Petals and SWARM decentralized training and inference
